gloss: going back to sleep; sleeping again after waking

definitions.gloss: going back to sleep; sleeping again after waking
definitions.explanation: Falling asleep again after having woken up, typically in the morning after the alarm goes off.

examples.japanese: {二度寝|にどね}してしまった。
{休日|きゅうじつ}の{二度寝|にどね}は{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: Going back to sleep on holidays is the best.

examples.japanese: {二度寝|にどね}したせいで{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I was late because I went back to sleep.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{二度|にど} (twice, second time) + {寝|ね} (sleeping)

USAGE:
Often associated with lazy weekend mornings or the temptation to sleep more after the alarm. Can have both positive connotations (comfort, relaxation) or negative ones (causing lateness).

RELATED SLEEP VOCABULARY:
・{寝不足|ねぶそく} - lack of sleep
・{夜更|よふ}かし - staying up late
・{寝坊|ねぼう} - oversleeping
・うたた{寝|ね} - dozing off

COLLOCATIONS:
・{二度寝|にどね}をする - to go back to sleep
・{二度寝|にどね}の{誘惑|ゆうわく} - the temptation to go back to sleep
